A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same circuit-analysis and CircuitLoRA study. Their text, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable; all 17 original figures and Appendices A–J can be matched across versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original mathematical-task experiments, circuit-evolution and robustness analyses, CircuitLoRA evaluations, and compositional-task results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and adds reported results on AdaLoRA comparisons, Union Circuit faithfulness, normalized circuit changes, and critical-layer selections.

M1.justification: EAP-IG discovery, Algorithm 1's two-phase CircuitLoRA procedure, and adaptation using unions of subtask circuits are retained. Expanded descriptions in Section 6.1 do not establish an algorithmic change.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Add/Sub across the same numerical ranges, Mul/Div, Sequence, LCM, Function, and two-step compositional arithmetic. The added appendix evaluations use this existing task coverage.

E2.justification: Appendix L, Table 6 adds a direct CircuitLoRA–AdaLoRA accuracy comparison across five tasks under similar parameter budgets. v1 already evaluated AdaLoRA in Appendix F's circuit-evolution comparisons, but did not include it in this direct comparison against CircuitLoRA.

E3.justification: Tables 1 and 4 change the higher-budget CircuitLoRA and RandomLoRA configurations from ro=32, rc=64 to ro=16, rc=64, retaining their scores and parameter ratios; this is a reported setting revision, not evidence of reruns. Appendix M adds evaluation at eight edge thresholds from 1% to 10%. Existing splits and training budgets are retained.

E4.justification: Appendix M adds a sensitivity analysis of Union Circuit faithfulness versus retained-edge percentage, and Appendix N compares critical-layer selections across tasks. These extend the existing analyses; the perturbation, PEFT, full-fine-tuning and model-size investigations remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Section 5.2 retains reporting final accuracy as the mean of five runs with different random seeds. No new uncertainty estimates, confidence intervals, significance tests or explicit increases in repeated runs are reported.

E6.justification: Appendices K–N substantially expand reported results with node/edge rates, direct AdaLoRA comparison entries, Union Circuit faithfulness across thresholds, and critical-layer rankings. Table 6 reports 76.70% for AdaLoRA versus 83.10% for CircuitLoRA on Add/Sub(300); Table 7 reports faithfulness rising from 67.4% at 1% of edges to 89.7% at 10%. Earlier table scores and figures are retained. Table 5's additional change-rate values are not reconciled with Figures 3 and 6.

T1.justification: The scoring, faithfulness, robustness, overlap and normalized-change formulas remain substantively unchanged. Appendix K repeats Section 4.2's normalization separately for nodes and edges, while Section 6.1 elaborates existing concepts. No new theorem, proof or formal assumption is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the central claims about edge-dominated circuit adaptation, CircuitLoRA's efficiency and accuracy, and compositional circuit approximation. The abstract's claimed average improvement of 2.46% is unchanged.

C2.justification: Appendix N newly interprets recurring critical layers as evidence of shared and task-specific adaptation locations. Appendix L attributes the advantage over AdaLoRA to circuit-driven rank allocation. The existing qualifications concerning mathematical tasks and two-step composition remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code-and-data repository access statement in the introduction and explicit task-specific critical-layer indices in Table 8. It also revises rank settings in Tables 1 and 4. Appendix A's training hyperparameters remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and Section 2's positioning relative to circuit analysis and parameter-efficient fine-tuning are retained. AdaLoRA was already cited and discussed; reference changes are bibliographic formatting.

P1.justification: Most prose and the existing section sequence are retained. Section 6.1 expands three brief descriptions into explanatory paragraphs, Appendices K–N add short sections, and v2 adds acknowledgements and revises affiliation information.

P2.justification: v2 comprehensively reformats the main text and references into a two-column conference layout, resizes and relocates existing figures and tables, and adds Tables 5–8. All 17 original figures are retained with unchanged graphical content.

improvement.justification: The direct AdaLoRA comparison, Union Circuit faithfulness sweep and reproducibility disclosures provide useful additions. However, Appendix K repeats the existing normalization while reporting 69.5% edge change for Add/Sub(100), versus roughly 15% in retained Figure 3, without explaining the discrepancy. Tables 1 and 4 also change ro to 16 while Section 5.2 retains ro=32. These unresolved inconsistencies affect central evidence and experimental settings, preventing a confident judgment of the net quality change.
